subject: Post-demo: Grounding validation checklist + pilot scope for Scout Health
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@scouthealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Grounding validation checklist + pilot scope for Scout Health

Hi Morgan — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap of what we heard and a proposed lightweight validation plan aligned to the pilot you asked about.

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Primary user flows: clinical note search, patient Q&A (non-PII for now), and care-path summarization.
- Data: ~18k internal SOP docs + ~120k historical notes (PII present) — you flagged SOC2 / PHI requirements and preferred VPC/private deployment.
- Success metrics: reduce mean time-to-answer by 40%, citation precision >= 90% for clinical-sourced answers, and hallucination rate < 2% per 1k requests.

Proposed validation scope (attached "pilot-proposal-scoped.pdf") — short run (3 weeks):
1) Model fit comparison: run 2 model families on a 2000-query prompt set (shared sample attached):
   - Candidate A: mixtral-8x (quantized) — low-latency baseline
   - Candidate B: vicuna-13b-instruct (Redwood-optimized) — higher-quality baseline
2) Retrieval configuration grid (to evaluate):
   - Embedding model: redwood-emb-small vs. all-mpnet-base-v2
   - Index shard/chunk strategy: 512-token vs 1,024-token chunks
   - Top-K retrieval: 10 vs 50 (with reranking)
3) Reranker experiments: cross-encoder (monoBERT-style) rerank of top-50 -> top-10 vs. simple dot-product re-rank (bi-encoder).
4) Grounding metrics to collect: exact grounding rate (cite present in top-1), hallucination rate (false assertions per 1k), citation precision@1, and retrieval latency.

Ask: can you confirm the 18k/120k counts and whether we should include historical notes in the pilot index, or limit to SOPs + curated knowledge? Also, are there any compliance docs we should prep for your legal team?

Next meeting: propose a 30-min pilot kickoff week of Apr 12 — let us know availability.

Attachments: pilot-proposal-scoped.pdf (PDF), scoping-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM Inference

- Compliance: legal has requested SOC2 docs and our DPA template be shared. I've CC'd legal; they will send the SOC2 link.

We prefer VPC deployment eventually, but for the pilot we can use Redwood Hosted with a strict data retention policy (7-day cache) if you surface that in the proposal.

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Grounding validation checklist + pilot scope for Scout Health

Hi Morgan / team — quick technical clarifications and concrete recommendations so the pilot produces actionable results:

Retrieval + index settings to include in the grid:
- Chunking: 700-token sliding window with 30% overlap usually balances recall and noise for clinical docs; we should test 512 vs 700 vs 1024 but label 700 as our default.
- Embedding model: run experiments with redwood-emb-small (faster / cheaper) and all-mpnet-base-v2 (higher fidelity). We should compute pairwise retrieval recall@k across the 2000-query set.
- Sharding: single-shard for the pilot to keep latency consistent; we can observe tail latency and then scale.

Reranker guidance:
- Do a cross-encoder rerank for quality-sensitive flows (patient Q&A). Use a distilled monoBERT variant for latency-sensitive reranks (target per-request rerank < 120ms P50).
- Setup: retrieve top-50 by embedding similarity, rerank top-50 -> top-10 with cross-encoder for evaluation metric consistency (precision@1, MRR).

Grounding / evaluation metrics (concrete instrumentation):
- Citation Precision@1: percent where top-1 answer includes a correct citation to source material (manual-label on 500 samples).
- Hallucination Rate: number of factually incorrect assertions per 1k outputs (manual labeling; define taxonomy).
- Retrieval Recall@10 / Recall@50: automatic metric vs. human judgment.
- Latency: P50/P95 end-to-end for generation plus retrieval/rerank.

Prompt sets & eval harness: I'll upload three prompt buckets to the Drive link (one-liners, multi-turn Qs, long-context summarization). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExamplePilotAssets

Operational notes: for the hosted pilot we will enable prefix caching and set token retention to 7 days as requested. If legal confirms SOC2 and DPA, we can propose a VPC start for the production rollout.
